name: Page
description: Represents a page in a workbook. Use the Page object and the related methods and properties for programmatically defining page layout in a workbook.
remarks: Use the Item property to access a specific page in a workbook. The following example accesses the first page in the active workbook.

properties.name: LeftHeader
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be left-aligned in the page header.

properties.name: CenterHeader
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be center-aligned in the page header.

properties.name: RightHeader
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be right-aligned in the page header.

properties.name: LeftFooter
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be left-aligned in the page footer.

properties.name: CenterFooter
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be center-aligned in the page footer.

properties.name: RightFooter
properties.description: Specifies a picture or text to be right-aligned in the page footer.
